title: Requesting a status report
body_md: A status report can be requested at any time – either by text message to the Pro-finder number or, outside the two operating modes reserved for the alarm system, by a call. On a call, Pro-finder ends it after a few dial tones and responds with a status report.
prev_context: Section 5.2 ends on the previous page.
next_context: The explanation of the GPS status in the report follows.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 22: equivalent in substance, including the exclusion of the two operating modes. The command string is not reproduced (BLK-005).
